recaps.headline: Mean Machine Dropped 177.24 on the League
recaps.dek: The widest margin of the week: Mean Machine over Les Pingouins 🐧 by 63.62.
paragraphs: Nobody topped 177.24 this week, and that number belonged to Mean Machine, who beat Les Pingouins 🐧 (113.62). The league median was 113.71.
At the other end, Lavaltree's Piggy managed 73, the lowest total in the league.

Hard-luck award: La Quiche. 133.98 points was the fourth-highest score of the week, and it lost to T-Bone Ray's (161.98). MTL New Empire won with 93.02, the fourth-lowest score of the week. Nobody asked how; the win counts.

Out front at 4-0: Montreal Weapon X, ahead of one other team with that record on the points tiebreak. Montreal Weapon X arrived at 4 consecutive wins this week, with no apparent plans to stop. Cold streak: Tebows before Hoes, 4 losses in a row and still falling. Last place belongs to Tebows before Hoes, at 0-4.
